title: Reconstructed requirements for one pull request
description: Output contract for the extraction step. One instance per pull request. Target format EARS+29148, decision C5. Schema version 1.

pull_number.description: Pull request number as stored in the prepared dataset.

processing_status.description: no_requirements_found is a valid result and must be distinguishable from a failed run.

status_reason.description: Required whenever processing_status is not requirements_found.

id.description: QR-<pull number, four digits>-<running number within the pull request>. Unique and never reused, 29148 clause 5.2.8.2.

text.description: The requirement sentence in English, EARS syntax, decision C5 section 6.

system_name.description: Taken from the source where it names a component, otherwise Qrisp. Decision C5 section 6.

type.description: Attribute Type, value set from 29148 clause 5.2.8.3.

security_relevant.description: Separate from type, because 29148 clause 5.2.8.3 subsumes security under quality. Needed for FF4.

rationale.description: Attribute Rationale, 29148 clause 5.2.8.2: why the requirement is needed. Carries the beneficiary as prose, decision C5 section 5.

beneficiary.description: Optional. Role or beneficiary, only if the source names one. Null otherwise. Makes the coverage rate countable for FF1.

component.description: Optional. Affected file path or module, as named in the source.

verification.description: Optional. How fulfilment could be checked.

source_excerpt.description: Verbatim excerpt from the prepared dataset. Must occur literally in the record named by source.

evidence_strength.description: Provisional value set. The classification rules are open and are fixed in decision E6.

uncertainties.description: Optional. What the model itself found unclear, in prose. No numeric confidence.

missing_information.description: Optional. What the source does not say.

modality_set_by_convention.description: Fixed marker. The word shall is a convention of this thesis and not evidence of a documented obligation. Decision C5 section 3.

locator.description: Comment id for a comment, file path for a diff, null for title and body.

html_url.description: Stable link, taken from the dataset. Never composed by the model.
